price_type.description: The price type that credit grants can apply to. We currently only support the `metered` price type. This refers to prices that have a [Billing Meter](https://docs.stripe.com/api/billing/meter) attached to them. Cannot be used in combination with `prices`.

prices.description: The prices that credit grants can apply to. We currently only support `metered` prices. This refers to prices that have a [Billing Meter](https://docs.stripe.com/api/billing/meter) attached to them. Cannot be used in combination with `price_type`.
